items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And he had people like Cy Touff was with him, the bass trumpeter, and I forget who else.

ctx.x: And he had people like Cy Touff was with him, the bass trumpeter, and I forget who else. He had a little band, and he played music for the kids. I guess it was something like Sesame Street-type stuff, and he did that for a few years to keep the money coming in, you know. And then he broke out and had his little band again, with Conte Candoli and Lou Levy and I forget who all else.
I just remember one of his - one of the pieces the band played - was Father Knickerbocker.
